assignments.title: Digital Assignment 2
assignments.subject: Advanced Cloud Computing
assignments.instructions:
Digital Assignment – II  Answer any two questions from the below. Each question
carries 5 marks. Total 10 marks. Write it in A4 sheets with your name and
registration number on each page.  1.   
 A growing  online
education platform  is migrating its learning management system
to AWS. The platform experiences high traffic during examinations and
assignment deadlines but relatively low traffic at other times. The
organization wants the system to remain reliable, automatically recover from
failures, deploy application updates safely, and avoid unnecessary cloud
expenses.  As an AWS cloud
architect:  a)  How would you design the AWS
architecture using  automation and monitoring 
to ensure efficient operations, rapid detection of issues, and automatic
recovery from failures?  b)  How can the  AWS Well-Architected Framework  be applied
when designing a  CI/CD pipeline 
to enable safe, automated deployments and improve the resilience of the
application?  c)  What  resource
optimization and cost-management strategies  would you implement
to reduce AWS costs while maintaining the required performance, availability,
security, and reliability?    2.   
 A  food-delivery
application  hosted on AWS experiences sudden increases in users
during weekends, holidays, and special events. The company wants the
application to remain available even if some servers or an entire AWS
Availability Zone fails. It also wants resources to scale automatically during
peak demand and have a recovery mechanism for major regional failures.  a)  How would you design an AWS architecture
using  Auto Scaling and load balancing  to
handle sudden traffic increases while ensuring  high
availability and fault tolerance  without a single point of
failure?  b)  How can  elastic
resources and disaster recovery strategies  be integrated to
ensure that the application can automatically recover and continue operating if
an  AWS Region becomes unavailable ?    3. A  healthcare organization  is hosting a
patient-management application on AWS. Different employees, doctors,
administrators, and application services require different levels of access.
The organization wants to prevent unauthorized access and ensure that its AWS
environment follows the  Shared Responsibility Model .  a)  How would you design  IAM policies and roles  to implement the  principle of least privilege , while clearly
separating AWS's security responsibilities from the organization's
responsibilities for securing users, applications, and AWS resources?  b)  How can  MFA, IAM
roles, permission policies, and regular access reviews  be used
together to strengthen access security and fulfill the organization's
responsibilities under the  AWS Shared Responsibility
Model ?    4. A large  financial services company  has multiple AWS
accounts for development, testing, and production within an AWS Organization.
The company wants to protect sensitive customer and transaction data using
centralized encryption, enforce consistent security policies, and continuously
identify vulnerabilities in its AWS resources.  a)  How can  AWS KMS
and AWS Organizations  be used together to centrally manage
encryption keys, access permissions, and key-rotation policies across multiple
AWS accounts while maintaining consistent security standards?  b)  How can  Amazon
Inspector  be integrated with the organization's KMS-based
security policies to identify vulnerabilities and ensure that AWS resources
comply with the required encryption and security standards?    5. A video-streaming company is planning to
migrate its application to AWS. The company expects rapidly changing user
demand and wants the application to be secure, reliable, scalable,
cost-effective, and easy to manage.  As an AWS cloud architect, explain how the AWS
Cloud Design Principles can be applied to design an efficient and reliable
architecture for the video-streaming application. Discuss the major design
principles and explain how each principle contributes to scalability, security,
reliability, performance, and cost optimization.    6. A software development team wants to build
an application that interacts with AWS services programmatically. The
developers want to use a programming language to access AWS resources, perform
operations, and integrate AWS services into their application without manually
using the AWS Management Console.  a) Identify and explain the AWS SDK (Software
Development Kit) and describe how it helps developers interact with AWS
services programmatically.   b) Explain how an AWS SDK can be used in an
application to authenticate with AWS, access an AWS service, and perform
operations on AWS resources. Give a suitable example.

assignments.title: AWS ASSIGNMENT I
assignments.subject: Advanced Cloud Computing
assignments.instructions: Dear Students,   Assignment: AWS Services   1. Select any TWO AWS services and access them through the AWS Management Console. 2. Take clear screenshots of the selected services. 3. Prepare a PDF report containing all the screenshots. 4. The first page should be a cover page with the following details:    - Student Name    - Registration Number    - Course Name    - Assignment Title: AWS Services: 5. Every page of the PDF must include your Name and Registration Number (either in the header or footer). 6. Ensure that all screenshots are clear, properly labeled, and arranged neatly.   Submit the PDF before the specified deadline.
